note: Publishes settable input gain from -15 dB to +15 dB, measured on this machine. Set it for a healthy level before using software trim; too much can clip at the converter. The headphone jack publishes -62 dB to -11 dB. One input channel at 44.1 or 48 kHz, 24-bit; the three-way capsule split is a V3 Pro feature and this microphone does not have it.

inputChannels.name: Microphone
inputChannels.detail: The capsule, in mono. This microphone offers one channel and no dry or expanded version of it.
